parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures: (1) Two questions ("How did she do?" + "Want me to book the next one?") when watchFor explicitly requires exactly one question; (2) Assumes it happened and went well ("Hope the 4pm session was amazing"); (3) Invented specifics (time "4pm", pronoun "she"); (4) Offers to do something next (book the next session); (5) Points at a link (www.example.com); (6) Greeting, emoji, and exclamation mark ("Hi there!", "😊"); (7) Padding after the question. This violates nearly every principle of the 5-point standard.
